Chargen.Title: Create Crawler
Chargen.OpenHint: Walk through character creation: backgrounds, combat Skill, Stats, past and starting stuff.

Step.past: Past Traumas, Loose Ends, and Regrets

Hint.crawler: Your name, pronouns and crawler number. Leave the number blank, type one (500,000 to 12,900,000 avoids the books' crawlers), or roll one.
Hint.animal: An animal crawler gives up its starting AI Favor, uses the animal backgrounds and starts with Slice Attack instead of Unarmed Combat.
Hint.backgrounds: For each stage of life, pick a background (or roll for it), then two of its three Skills. No double-dipping: a Skill can only come from one background.
Hint.combat: You start with {skill} at Rank 3. Pick your second combat Skill, also at Rank 3: the weapon you brought in, an attack Spell, or a hand-to-hand Skill (an animal can also take another strike). It can't be a Skill a background already gave you.
Hint.spell: An attack Spell needs Intelligence {min} or higher. You also get 5 Mana Potions, in one Hotlist slot.
Hint.handToHand: You also get the Damage Effect at Rank 3, and the GM owes you a Bronze Weapon Box (with a shitty drawback).
Hint.stats: Standard Array: place 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, each once. Leaving it to Chance: roll 1d6 for each Stat in order, rerolling 1s - no swapping.
Hint.past: Pick from the table, roll, or write your own. These tell your GM what stories you want to tell.
Hint.stuff: Whatever was on you when the collapse happened: clothes, your weapon, one useful item and something weird. Pick an example set or write your own.
Hint.review: Check everything, then create the crawler. Heal (Rank 1) comes with every crawler.

Chargen.TakenElsewhere: Already taken from another background or as a combat Skill

Combat.WeaponNameHint: e.g. Tire Iron, if it works like the one picked

Chargen.Derived: Health Bar slots of {hb} each, {mana} Mana, Evade d20 + {evade}.

Problem.Name: Give your crawler a name.
Problem.NoAnimals: Animal crawlers aren't allowed in this world.
Problem.MustRoll: {stage}: backgrounds are rolled in this world.
Problem.Duplicate: {skill} is taken twice: each Skill can only come from one place.
Problem.SpellInt: An attack Spell needs Intelligence {min} or higher: pick another combat Skill.
Problem.MethodOff: That Stat method isn't allowed in this world.
Problem.ArrayIncomplete: Place a score in every Stat.
Problem.AlreadyDone: {name} has already been through character creation.

Summary.Title: New crawler: {name}
Summary.WeaponBox: Entered the dungeon unarmed: the GM owes a Bronze Weapon Box.

Settings.StatMethodsHint: How players set their starting Stats: the Standard Array (2, 3, 4, 5, 6), rolling (1d6, rerolling 1s, in order), or either.
Settings.BackgroundMethodsHint: Whether players choose their backgrounds, roll for them, or either.
Settings.AllowAnimalsHint: Let players make an animal crawler (one per group, giving up their starting AI Favor).

Companions.Heading: From the old Pet tab
Companions.Intro: Carried over from {name}'s old Pet tab. These values have no field of their own on this sheet.
Companions.Crawler: Its crawler (bond it once both are in the world)
Companions.Failed: Couldn't move the old Pet tab of: {names}. Their data is kept and it will be tried again next load - see the console (F12).

Migration.Begin: Updating this world's Carl RPG data for {version}. Please don't close the world until it says it's done.
Migration.Done: This world's Carl RPG data is up to date for {version} ({count} change(s)).
Migration.Failed: This world's Carl RPG data was updated for {version} ({count} change(s)), but {errors} item(s) couldn't be - see the console (F12) for which.

Refresh.Title: Items updated from the compendium
Refresh.Body: These Races, Classes, Skills and Spells now apply their DR, Move, Step and Evade automatically. Each copy below had those bonuses brought up to the compendium's (nothing else on it changed):
Refresh.CheckMove: (base Move {move} ft, Step {step} ft were typed in by hand: check they don't already include what these now add)

GearSlots.Title: Gear says where it's worn now
GearSlots.Body: Each piece of gear now has the slots it's worn in (Worn on, on its sheet), and the Equipment Doll keeps to them: one Belt and one Cape, and a two-handed weapon takes both hands. This gear was worn where it doesn't fit, so it's been taken off - put it back where it goes:

GearSlotsUnplaced.Title: Gear with no slot
GearSlotsUnplaced.Body: Couldn't tell where this gear is worn, so it can't be worn until its sheet says where (Worn on) - though it can still be held in a hand. By who has it; anything marked "taken off" was worn and is now unequipped:

MobAttacks.Title: Mob Attacks are items now
MobAttacks.Body: Each Mob's Attacks are now items on its sheet, with an Area box and the Debuffs they give. These Mobs have Attacks to check: one guessed to be an Area Attack, or one whose effect names a Debuff - set the Debuff, and when it lands, on the Attack:

BaseDr.Title: Base DR is now 0
BaseDr.Body: A crawler's DR now comes only from its Race, Class, gear, Skills, Spells and Buffs. These Characters had a base DR typed in, which is now 0. If it came from something not automated yet, add it back as a DR bonus on that item:

DeityTier.Title: Deity Tiers filled in
DeityTier.Body: Characters now have a church Tier in their Deity block, and a Boon tagged with a Tier only applies at or below it. These Characters had no Tier yet, so each was given the highest Tier among its Boons, to keep them working. Check them on the Benefits tab:

WeaponSkill.Title: New: Weapon Skill
WeaponSkill.Body: Gear items now have a Weapon Skill field: the Attack Skill the item is wielded with (e.g. Longsword). An Attack with a Weapon Skill now needs a weapon in hand or in the Hotlist whose Weapon Skill names it. Weapons made before this update have it blank, so GM and players: open each of your weapons and set its Weapon Skill. Hand-to-hand Skills, Improvised Weapons and natural attacks need no weapon.

Hotlist.Title: Hotlist

Hint.Cast: Cast this Spell (the Cast a Spell Action).
Hint.Use: Use it (the Use a Hotlist Item Action) - asks first.
Hint.Ready: Swap it into your Main Hand. In a fight: the Use a Hotlist Item Action, or free when you swap weapons as part of an Attack.

Hotlist.PinHint: Put it in the Hotlist, or take it out (in a fight, adding one is the Retrieve Action).
Hotlist.PinSpellHint: Put it in the Hotlist - in a fight, a Spell can only be cast from there (p.86).
Hotlist.Full: Your Hotlist is full: clear or swap an entry first.
Hotlist.NotInHotlist: {name} isn't in your Hotlist: in a fight, Retrieve it first (an Action, p.86).
Hotlist.SlotTaken: Hotlist slot {number} filled up meanwhile: pick an empty one.

Refuse.Worn: {name} is worn: take it off first - Hotlist items give no benefits (p.98).
Refuse.Untrained: {name} has no Ranks: an untrained Spell can't be cast.

Pick.Title: Hotlist slot {number}
Pick.NothingToAdd: Nothing to add: worn gear and anything already in the Hotlist aren't listed.

Retrieve.Title: Retrieve
Retrieve.Rule: Retrieve is an Action, and the item can't be used during that same Action (p.86).

Swap.Title: Ready {item}
Swap.BodySwap: {item} goes into your Main Hand, and {previous} takes its Hotlist slot.
Swap.Rule: Swapping is the Use a Hotlist Item Action - or free when you swap weapons as part of an Attack (p.98).
Swap.InProgress: Finish the swap that's under way first.
Swap.UndoSkipped: The Attack didn't happen, but your hands or Hotlist changed meanwhile, so the swap stands (an Action).
Swap.Failed: {item} couldn't go into your Main Hand: nothing was swapped.

Hotlist.ReadyRule: Use a Hotlist Item (an Action, p.98).
Hotlist.ReadyFreeRule: Free: a weapon swapped as part of the Attack (p.98).

Vehicle.OccupancyHint: How many fit, the driver included (Table 7).
Vehicle.CargoHint: Extra people in a cargo area, e.g. an 18-wheeler's "(+50 in cargo)".
Vehicle.SlotValueHint: Each Health Bar slot holds the vehicle's Size. Set this only for an odd vehicle.
Vehicle.PresetHint: Fill in Move, Size, DR, Occupancy, cargo and the driving Skill from Table 7 (p.73).

UpgradeHints.nitrous: Speed Buff: double Move for 3 rounds. One charge - tick it again to refill.
UpgradeHints.shockAbsorbers: Magical Buff: once per Floor, improve a Driving Check Fail by one level.
UpgradeHints.fuzzyDice: Pimping Your Ride: one Driving Check reroll per Floor.

Vehicle.NitrousFired: {vehicle} hits the Nitrous: double Move for {rounds} rounds.
Vehicle.WeaponsHint: Fired by an occupant: d20 + their Rank in the weapon's Skill + the Stat. The driver fires these without the Driving Disadvantage. A GM-crewed vehicle fires them at the to-hit instead.
Vehicle.FireHint: Fire at your targets as an occupant.
Vehicle.FireAsCrewHint: Fire at its to-hit, as the GM's crew.
Vehicle.NoGunner: Nobody aboard {vehicle} can fire it for you.
Vehicle.Empty: Nobody aboard. Drag a crawler here, or use Board.
Vehicle.BoardSelectedHint: Put every selected token aboard - the way to seat Mobs.
Vehicle.NoBoarder: Select your token, or have an assigned character, to board.
Vehicle.NoneSelected: Select the tokens to put aboard.
Vehicle.BoardMoving: {name} jumps into the moving {vehicle} (a Move Action, DEX {dc}).
Vehicle.NeedsGM: A GM must be online to change a vehicle you don't own.
Vehicle.NotACombatant: {name} is a vehicle: it has no Actions, so it can't join the fight - its occupants do.
Vehicle.NotHealed: Vehicles are repaired (edit the Health Bar), not healed.
Vehicle.MobDriver: {name} doesn't roll - set this round's result on the Details tab.
Vehicle.NotYourVehicle: Only the GM or whoever plays the driver can do that.
Vehicle.MoveHint: Max {max} (base {base} + {bonus} from the driver's Ranks; doubled by Nitrous).
Vehicle.RoundOverrideHint: Set this round's Driving Check result by hand - for a Mob driver, who doesn't roll.
Vehicle.DifficultyHint: To hit it: 10 + its current Move ÷ 5 (no Floor). Vehicles don't Evade.
Vehicle.RulesReminder: Getting into it while it moves: DEX {board}. Stopping in time: Driving {stop}. Occupants Evading: +{buff}, except from straight ahead or behind. No drive-bys: the vehicle must end its move in range.
Vehicle.DrivingCheckHint: Table 6: the driver's Unopposed Check sets this round's Move.
Vehicle.StopCheckHint: Stopping in time: Driving vs. 10 + Move ÷ 5. On a success you stop where you want.
Vehicle.StopFail: You don't stop in time - the GM decides what happens.

Outcome.criticalHit: Pick one: +50% Move this round, or 1 AI Favor.
Outcome.amazingSuccess: Full Move this round, and Advantage on your next Check to operate this vehicle.
Outcome.nearMissFail: The vehicle loses 5 feet of Move this round.
Outcome.standardFail: The vehicle loses half its Move this round.
Outcome.majorFail: Half Move this round, and the vehicle takes 10% damage (1 slot).
Outcome.criticalFail: You stall: no Move this round, and the vehicle takes 30% damage (3 slots).

Ram.Hint: Ram your target: Driving vs. its Evade, (Size + Move ÷ 10)d6 Bludgeoning.
Ram.Title: {name} rams with {vehicle}
Ram.NotMoving: {vehicle} has to be moving to ram.
Ram.Recoil: The rammer takes half the damage and halves its Move; its occupants take half of what it takes.
Ram.LargerTarget: The target is larger: the rammer takes full damage and stops dead; its occupants take half of what it takes.
Ram.NoRecoil: The ram missed - {vehicle} takes no recoil.
Ram.OccupantsAdded: {vehicle}'s occupants take {damage} each (before their own DR).

Explosion.Title: {vehicle} explodes!
Explosion.Body: Everyone inside takes the blast. The vehicle's DR doesn't protect them; their own does.

Pet.NoAdvancement: A Pet's Ranks equal the Floor and can't be raised (p.231).
Pet.IntLocked: A Pet's Intelligence only rises with an Enhanced Pet Biscuit (GM).
Pet.RankIsFloorHint: Pets have no Skill Ranks of their own: every Rank equals the current Floor (p.231).
Pet.NoClassOrRace: Pets don't have a Class or Race.
Pet.SetInDetails: Set its crawler on the Details tab.
Pet.LevelHint: Levels with its crawler: 2 Levels per crawler Level until 15, then 1 (p.231). Edit it on the Details tab.
Pet.HbSlotsHint: Size + Level - 1, up to 10 (a mount: its Size). Leave blank to use the rule.
Pet.IsMountHint: A dedicated mount: its Health Bar slots equal its Size and it never levels (p.232). Leave unticked for a Pet you ride with a saddle.
Pet.IsMinionHint: A minion (p.233): no Command Check - one command covers them, and it fights with its two Actions in any combat. Spells for pets (Heal Critter) work on it; Heal Others doesn't.
Pet.AttitudeHint: Hostile, Calm, Friendly or Bonded (p.230). Changing it takes 20 minutes and an Animal Handling Check.

RoleRules.tank: Tank: DR + Floor, and one Special Ability.
RoleRules.aggressive: Aggressive: Back Claw and Bite, + Floor damage on its Attacks, and no Special Abilities.

Pet.EvadeHint: 10 + DEX Mod + Floor: what an attacker sees. Its crawler rolls its Evade when it's attacked.
Pet.SpecialAbilityCountHint: Chosen / allowed by its Role: Tank 1, Utility 2, Aggressive 0 (p.231).
Pet.HeightenedSensesHint: Where crawlers make such Skill Checks, make a Stat Check for the Pet vs. the same Difficulty (p.231).
Pet.MatureBenefitHint: At Level 15 the Pet is mature and gains a new benefit, e.g. Earthquake, Wrecking Ball, Spells, Regeneration (p.231).
Pet.EarthBornHint: An Earth-born Pet with Intelligence 2 or higher becomes a full-fledged crawler (p.228).
Pet.IntWarning: Intelligence 2+: this Earth-born Pet becomes a crawler and is no longer a Pet (p.228).

Command.Title: Command {name}
Command.DcHint: Its crawler's INT-Opposed Animal Handling Check: 10 + the Pet's INT Mod + Floor (p.230).
Command.OverrideHint: GM: set this fight's command result by hand.

Rules.free: It fights for the whole combat with its two Actions, used as it, or you, please.
Rules.restricted: It fights for the whole combat with two Actions, only to Evade, Move or Attack, and attacks once per round.
Rules.stayingOut: It stays out of the fight. You may try again with future Actions.
Rules.hiding: It runs out of sight and hides. Find it after the fight and coax it out.

Command.NoOwner: {name} has no crawler to command it.
Command.NotAllowed: Only the GM, or whoever plays {name}'s crawler, can command it.
Command.NeedsCombat: Command Pet needs a combat that has started.
Command.Untrained: Untrained in Animal Handling: rolled with Disadvantage.
Command.HidingAfterFight: {name} is still hiding. Find it and coax it out.
Command.WarnRestricted: {name} may only Evade, Move or Attack this fight.
Command.MinionNoCheck: {name} is a minion: it follows commands without a Command Check (p.233).

CrawlerForge.NotInRulebookHint: Imported from CrawlerForge, which made this up: it isn't in our compendiums or the rulebook. Keep it, edit it or swap it for a rulebook one.

Report.Title: CrawlerForge import: {name}
Report.AllMatched: Everything matched our compendiums and was placed.
Report.NotInRulebook: Not in the rulebook (imported as written, marked "Not in rulebook")
Report.Granted: Granted by the Race or Class, not in the export (made at that Rank)
Report.NoWeapon: Attack Skills with no weapon in the export (can't attack until one is given that Weapon Skill)
Report.GearUnmatched: Gear not in our compendiums (imported as written)

UnplacedReason.noExportSlot: {name}: equipped in CrawlerForge with no slot
UnplacedReason.unknownSlot: {name}: CrawlerForge slot "{slot}" isn't one of ours
UnplacedReason.noSlot: {name}: can't be worn (no slot, or a consumable)
UnplacedReason.full: {name}: no free slot for it (CrawlerForge slot "{slot}")

Report.Unmapped: Effects and fields with no match here (in the description or Upgrade text only)
Report.Background: Background text not in the book's tables

Field.ManaCost: Mana cost "{value}" isn't a number (set to 1)
Field.Interrupt: Interrupt (a Skill has no Interrupt keyword)

Note.Campaign: CrawlerForge campaign "{campaign}" isn't kept (no field for it here).
Note.RaceNotFound: Race "{name}" isn't in our Classes & Races compendium.
Note.ClassNotFound: Class "{name}" isn't in our Classes & Races compendium.
Note.Species: Species "{species}" isn't a kind of crawler we know (human or animal).
Note.NoWeaponSkill: {name} is a {skill} weapon; the crawler has no {skill} Skill.
Note.OurBonuses: {name}: our compendium item's bonuses kept; CrawlerForge's effects for it left off.
Note.CopyFailed: {name}: its compendium copy couldn't be read, so CrawlerForge's own version was used (check it).
Note.TableUnread: The {table} table couldn't be read, so that background text wasn't checked.

PdfImport.Title: Import Rulebook PDF
PdfImport.MenuHint: Read your own copy of a Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG book into this world: gear, spells, Mobs, achievements and maps.
PdfImport.PickHint: Pick your own copy of a Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG book. It is read in your browser; nothing is uploaded except map images, which are saved to your Foundry Data folder.
PdfImport.GMOnly: Only the GM can import a rulebook.
PdfImport.ResultsHint: Found in {title}. Mobs, items and achievements go into compendiums named after the book (spells and gear a compendium already has are copied from it), maps into a Scenes folder; importing the same book again updates those documents instead of copying them, except ones you've edited since.
PdfImport.MapsHint: Pages that look like maps are checked. Uncheck any that are art, or check any the importer missed.
PdfImport.SummarySkipped: ({skipped} skipped: edited since the last import)
PdfImport.SkippedEdited: Not overwritten because you've edited them since the last import, or made them yourself (delete one and import again to refresh it): {names}
PdfImport.LowQuality: {title} looks like the low-quality (LQ) edition of the book: its pictures are about {ppi} pixels per inch. The importer reads only the full-quality PDF, because the LQ files garble the text it reads and their maps are low resolution. Download the standard version of the book and import that instead.
PdfImport.NoWebp: This browser cannot save WebP images.

Toolbox.Title: GM Toolbox
Toolbox.GMOnly: Only the GM can open the GM Toolbox.
Toolbox.ResolveTwoHourPickerPrompt: Choose who played these 2 hours. Each gains 1 Level, and their marked Skills at Rank 4 or lower roll Advancement Checks (Rank 5+ waits for End Floor).
Toolbox.EndFloorHint: Rank 5+ Advancement Checks, erase all marks, end-of-floor Popularity, then go to the next Floor.
Toolbox.EndFloorPickerPrompt: Choose who is descending. Their marked Skills at Rank 5+ roll Advancement Checks, all marks are erased, and Popularity changes by their Charisma. The Floor then advances by 1.

EndFloorReminder.Cooldowns: "Once per Floor" and "once per X days" cooldowns reset.
EndFloorReminder.Popularity: Other end-of-floor Popularity calls (p.280): +1 for a cute Pet moment or a memorable catchphrase; -1 for a boring d10+ main Attack, entering the stairwell 30+ hours early, or grinding 15+ of the final 30 hours.
EndFloorReminder.Boxes: Fan Box for high performers (one per Floor); a Benefactor Box if they have a Sponsor (once per Floor).
EndFloorReminder.RaceClass: Race/Class end-of-floor features, e.g. Human's or Hobgoblin's extra Advancement Check with Advantage.
EndFloorReminder.Collapse: Floor {floor} collapses in {days} days (30-hour days) unless you set your own.
EndFloorReminder.CollapseCustom: Set Floor {floor}'s collapse timer and announce it.

Toolbox.BossKilledHint: Award Levels for a Boss kill by its tier (p.170).
Toolbox.BossKilledPickerPrompt: Choose the party members who gain the Levels.
Toolbox.MendHint: Each full hour outside combat or stress: +1 HB slot and +5 Mana (p.95). Advances the world clock.
Toolbox.MendPickerPrompt: Choose who spent these hours mending.
Toolbox.TwoHourReachedBody: The Play Timer has reached 2 hours. Resolve the 2-Hour Tick (Advancement Checks and +1 Level) whenever you're ready - this does not happen automatically.

Rest.Title: Rest

Rule.short: Heal 5 Health Bar slots. Crawlers also regenerate half of their total Mana (rounded down), so if they have 15 Intelligence, they regain 7 Mana.
Rule.long: After a long rest, a crawler is as good as new with a full Health Bar and Mana. A long rest also removes all instances of the Fatigued Debuff.
Rule.fullDay: Required to recover from long-term injuries (see Injuries, p. 96), a full day of rest also recovers their full Health Bar and all Mana.

Rest.PickerPrompt: Choose which characters rest. Not everyone has to - someone could be on watch or otherwise occupied.

Toolbox.AdvanceTimeHint: Moves the world clock forward {hours}. Untick it when that time is already being counted - say, some crawlers rest while others grind for the same hours.
Toolbox.ClockAdvanced: The world clock moved forward {hours} hours.
Toolbox.RestAppliedNone: No characters were selected - no rest was applied.

ActorPicker.NotLoggedInHint: Characters whose player isn't connected right now, or that only the GM plays. Tick any to include them.

Toolbox.NewSceneHint: Start a new scene: every "Once per scene" cooldown ends, for every actor.
Toolbox.NewSceneDone: New scene: "Once per scene" cooldowns are cleared.
Toolbox.GrindThresholdReached: {name} has accrued enough hours - rolling a Skill Advancement Check.
Toolbox.LootNoItemTypeTable: Could not find the "Item Type" table in the Roll Tables compendium.

Actor.EliteHint: An Elite, like a Boss, has 1 Action per crawler in the fight each round (p.81).
Actor.ActionsPerRoundHint: Actions per round, when the stat block sets its own. Blank: a Mob gets 1 Move + 1 Action; an Elite or Boss 1 Action per crawler.
Actor.AiFavorHint: Spend 1 to reroll a d20 (not a Nat 1) or, once per round, take an extra non-Attack Action (p.61).
Actor.StatPointsRemainingHint: Computed fresh from this Mob's Level and Tier - see the Spend Stat Points dialog for the exact formula.
Actor.BonusFromItemsSkills: Bonus from items/skills, applied on top of the base value
Actor.SurpriseHint: 10 + INT Mod, +Floor at time of use (p.271) - not baked in, since Floor can change without this Mob being re-saved.
Actor.EvadeHint: 10 + DEX Mod, +Floor at time of use (p.271) - the Difficulty crawlers' attacks must beat to hit this Mob.
Actor.HbSlotsOverrideHint: Leave blank to use the computed Level/Tier formula (shown as a placeholder); set a number to override it.
Actor.ResistanceGrantedHint: Overridden by an owned item's Resistance grant
Actor.AccessoriesFull: You can wear up to {max} Accessories.
Actor.SlotGearOnly: Only gear can go in a gear or accessory slot.
Actor.SponsorsHint: Crawlers are limited to three Sponsors each (p.284).
Actor.PotionsLimit: The most a crawler can drink in their life
Actor.PotionsUsedHint: A crawler may only consume two Stat potions and two Skill potions in their life (p.218).
Actor.EvadeTotalHint: DEX Mod + Evade bonuses (and any dice), added to the d20 on an Evade Check
Actor.ResistancesDialogHint: Resistances, Immunities and Vulnerabilities come from your Race, Class, worn gear and Buffs. Add or remove those to change them.

Skill.HandToHandHint: A hand-to-hand Combat Skill (p.179). Unarmed Combat drops off the Combat tab's Attacks once one of these outranks it.

Spell.ShieldSlotsHint: The extra Health Bar slots this Spell grants while it's switched on (a Shield-type Spell). 0: none.

DamageEffect.ParentSkillsHint: Attack Skills this Damage Effect can be selected for at attack time.

SkillChoice.Hint: "+X in a [category] Skill of your choice" - authored here without a fixed target; the owner picks a real Skill below, which materializes a permanent Change on this item.
SkillChoice.PickPlaceholder: Type or pick a Skill name
SkillChoice.NeedName: Type a Skill name before assigning this grant.

Benefits.NoText: No benefits text yet. Edit the item to add its benefits list.
Benefits.NoRaceOrClass: No Race or Class yet. Drop one on the sheet.

Deity.TitheHint: Share of all looted gold owed to your god's shrine: 5% Acolyte, 10% Devotee, 20% Zealot (pp.163-164), doubled or quadrupled under penance (p.312).
Deity.WorshipDaysHint: Consecutive days of worship (tithes and daily offerings). Every five earns a Boon (p.164).
Deity.ReceiveBoonHint: Roll Table 63 (Boons): adds a 30-hour Buff on the Conditions tab and takes five days off the count. Available once a Boon is due (the GM can grant one at any time).
Deity.Missed1: 1 missed offering: no worship benefits until the next offering, and the day count starts over
Deity.Missed2: 2 in a row: a Divine Debuff
Deity.Missed3: 3 in a row: Fallen from Grace
Deity.PenitenceHint: Penitence (p.312): a first offense doubles the tithe, a second quadruples it.
Deity.Suspended: Worship benefits are lost until the missed offering is made or the penance is paid (pp.163, 312).
Deity.NoTierBenefits: Add Benefits with a Tier for the deity's Acolyte, Devotee and Zealot benefits.
Deity.TierNotReached: Your church Tier is below this benefit's Tier, so it doesn't apply.
Deity.BenefitSuspended: Worship is suspended, so this benefit doesn't apply.
Deity.BoonNotAvailable: No Boon is due: it takes five consecutive days of worship, a church Tier, and no missed offering, Shunning or Fall from Grace.
Deity.NoBoonsTable: Could not find the "Boons" table in the Roll Tables compendium.

Ranked.HealAllTargetsHint: From this Rank it heals every targeted token instead of one (Heal Others Rank 15: all party members in a 20ft Burst - target them).
Ranked.HealsHint: Who it can be cast on. A heal with nothing targeted heals its caster, if it can.
Ranked.HealToFullBaseHint: At any Rank, heals the target's whole Health Bar with no dice (Heal Critter). An Upgrade's Heal to Full also grants a Short Rest.
Ranked.DamageTypeSplit: Damage Type Split (once unlocked, overrides/splits the default damage pool)

Change.TargetSkillPlaceholder: Type or pick a Skill/Spell name
Change.Label: Label

OnHitDebuff.NoAmazing: Only on an Amazing Success, and no target was one: it lands on no one.
OnHitDebuff.OnlyWithHint: Blank: any Attack. One "On an Amazing Success" effect per weapon (p.223).

TriggerHint.hit: Lands on any hit the target doesn't Evade.
TriggerHint.crit: Lands only on a Critical Hit.
TriggerHint.amazing: Lands only on an Amazing Success.
TriggerHint.both: Lands only on a Critical Hit that is also an Amazing Success.

ItemSheet.NoUpgradeHere: No Upgrade at this Rank yet.
ItemSheet.AddAnotherUpgrade: Add another Upgrade at this Rank
ItemSheet.MoveUpgrade: Move this Upgrade to another Rank

Gear.TwoHandedHint: "Limitation: Two-Handed": held in both hands, so nothing else can be held (p.98).
Gear.NotWearable: Can't be worn until you pick where it goes - though it can be held in a hand (no bonuses there unless it's Held).
Gear.NoSlot: {item} can't be worn: pick where it goes on its sheet (Worn on). It can still be held in a hand.
Gear.WrongSlot: {item} isn't worn there. It goes on: {slots}.
Gear.OneKind: Only one {kind} at a time: {item} is already worn.
Gear.NoFreeSlot: {item} has nowhere free to go ({slots}): take something off first.
Gear.ConsumableNotWorn: {item} is used, not worn: put it in your Hotlist.
Gear.TakenOff: {item} isn't worn where it was any more, so it was taken off.

Chat.NoGMOnline: No GM is currently connected to apply this action.

TargetEffects.NoTargets: No targets were selected when this roll was made.

Damage.DyingCountdown: {name} is Dying: the hit takes 1 off the countdown instead ({rounds} round(s) left).
Damage.NoTargets: No targets were selected when this roll was made.

Heal.BlockedByDebuff: {name} has {debuff} and can't be healed. Remove the Debuff first to apply this healing.
Heal.Subtitle: +{amount} HB
Heal.WillHeal: Heals {amount} Health Bar slot(s) when applied.
Heal.WillHealFull: Heals to full and grants the benefits of a Short Rest when applied.
Heal.WillHealNamed: Heals {names}: {amount} Health Bar slot(s) when applied.
Heal.WillHealFullRestNamed: Heals {names} to full and grants the benefits of a Short Rest when applied.
Heal.NoActor: The caster for this heal could no longer be found.
Heal.NoConditions: {name} has no active Conditions to mend.

Heals.ByRange: By Range (Self only: Self; else Anyone)
Heals.ChooseRecipient: {name} is targeted. Cast {spell} on them, or on yourself?

Refuse.NeedsTarget: {spell} can't be cast on yourself: target who to heal.
Refuse.NeedsPet: {spell} only heals pets and minions: target one.
Refuse.OneTarget: {spell} heals one target: target only one.
Refuse.Vehicle: {name} is a vehicle: it's repaired, not healed.
Refuse.NotPets: {spell} can't be cast on pets or minions ({name}).
Refuse.PetsOnly: {spell} may only be cast on pets and minions ({name} isn't one).

ArmorPiercing.Label: Armor-Piercing
ArmorPiercing.Hint: Armor-Piercing damage ignores DR, except DR from gear marked Anti-Piercing (p.95, p.225).
ArmorPiercing.WeaponHint: Attacks with this weapon are Armor-Piercing: they ignore DR, except DR from gear marked Anti-Piercing.
ArmorPiercing.AntiHint: Anti-Piercing (p.95): this piece's DR still applies against Armor-Piercing damage.

ShieldBlock.Name: Shield Block
ShieldBlock.Button: Shield Block: an Action for this Attack - half damage on a Success (p.198)
ShieldBlock.BashButton: Shield Bash: a free Attack at the attacker (Natural 20, Rank 10)
ShieldBlock.ShieldHint: A Shield (p.98): always held, in a hand. Its wielder can use the Shield Block Skill (p.198).
ShieldBlock.DamageHint: DR lost to Shield Blocks: -1 on a Major Fail, -2 on a Critical Fail. At 0 DR it's broken: no DR, and it can't block.
ShieldBlock.RepairHint: "A broken shield and lost DR can be Repaired" (p.198): clear its Shield damage.

PartyCheck.ButtonHint: A Party Skill Check (p.59): everyone rolls; half or more succeed and the party succeeds.
PartyCheck.NeedSkill: A Party Skill Check needs a Skill and a Difficulty.
PartyCheck.Rule: Each crawler rolls for themselves - no aiding (p.59). Half or more succeed: the party succeeds. Untrained: a Stat Check with Disadvantage.
PartyCheck.Title: Party Check: {skill}
PartyCheck.Subtitle: Difficulty {difficulty}
PartyCheck.Speaker: Party Skill Check
PartyCheck.ResultClosed: Closed: {successes} of the {rolled} who rolled succeeded (half or more needed; {total} were called).

Evade.NoBaseDamage: The original Attack rolled no damage to apply.
Evade.NoActor: Could not find the defending actor for this card.

Targets.EvadePending: Evade rolled - waiting for the GM to record it
Targets.ImmuneNoEffects: {name} is immune to this damage, so its Debuffs don't apply (p.93).
Targets.OldCard: This Attack card is from an older version - re-roll the Attack to get per-target Evade buttons.

Consumable.Title: Consumable

Confirm.Title: Use {item}?
Confirm.UseAction: In a fight, this is the Use a Hotlist Item Action.
Confirm.CastAction: In a fight, this is the Cast a Spell Action.
Confirm.Sickness: {name} had a potion within the last two rounds: this one brings on Potion Sickness (Poisoned).

Consumable.PotionHint: Applies to the one targeted token, or else the user. A Potion counts toward Potion Sickness (more than one every other round in combat); other items don't.
Consumable.PerRoundHint: Restored at the end of each combat round while the Buff lasts. A Buff measured in rounds ends after that many round ends, and with the combat.

SpellHint.scroll: Casts the Spell once at this Rank with no Mana, then turns to dust. Blank fields are read from a name like "Scroll of Magic Missile (Rank 3)".
SpellHint.spellbook: Teaches the Spell at this Rank (blank: 1d6-1, minimum 1), then disappears. Blank fields are read from a name like "Spellbook of Hole (Rank 2)".

Consumable.ChooseRecipient: {name} is targeted. Use {item} yourself, or give it to them?
Consumable.SpellbookKnown: {name} already knows {spell} at Rank {rank} - this book can't teach more. It's kept.
Consumable.ChooseSkillHint: Choose the Skill this potion raises.
Consumable.NoRecipient: Whoever this was for no longer exists.
Consumable.ApplyFailed: Couldn't apply it - see the console. Apply is still available to try again.
Consumable.NoStat: {item} doesn't say which Stat it raises - set it on the item.
Consumable.NoDuration: {item} restores something each round but doesn't say for how long - set its Buff's duration.
Consumable.SkillAtCap: {name}'s {skill} is already as high as it can go - the potion is kept.

LimitReached.stat: {name} has already drunk two Stat potions - the most a crawler ever can.
LimitReached.skill: {name} has already drunk two Skill potions - the most a crawler ever can.

Consumable.NoSpell: {item}: couldn't find the Spell "{spell}" - link it on the item.
Consumable.NoRank: {item} doesn't say its Rank - set it on the item.
Consumable.ScrollCast: Cast from a scroll at Rank {rank} - no Mana

Does.MendAny: Mends one Minor or Major Injury

Result.HealedAtOnce: {name} heals {slots} Health Bar slots from {buff} - all at once, outside a fight.
Result.ManaAtOnce: {name} regains {amount} Mana from {buff} - all at once, outside a fight.
Result.SkillAtCap: {name}'s {skill} is already at its highest Rank ({rank}) - nothing gained.
Result.CrawlersOnly: Only a crawler can gain a permanent boost - {name} gets nothing from it.

LimitReached.stat: {name} has already drunk two Stat potions - this one does nothing.
LimitReached.skill: {name} has already drunk two Skill potions - this one does nothing.

Result.Sickness: Potion Sickness: {name} drank another potion within two rounds and is Poisoned until the end of next round.
Result.SpellKnown: {name} already knows {spell} at Rank {rank} - the book teaches nothing new.

Reroll.Closed: This Check can't be rerolled any more: its result has been used.
Reroll.Superseded: Rerolled with AI Favor - the newer card has the result.
Reroll.Missing: What this roll used is gone (its Skill or target), so it can't be rerolled.
Reroll.NoFavor: {name} has no AI Favor left to spend.

Taunt.Success: Success — the Attack now targets you!
Taunt.FailedNotice: {name}'s Taunt fails — the attack is unchanged.
Taunt.AlreadyResolved: This Attack has already been resolved and can no longer be redirected.
Taunt.CannotTauntSelf: You're already the target of this Attack.
Taunt.NoAttacker: Could not find the attacking Mob for this card.
Taunt.NoTauntSkill: You don't have the Taunt Skill.
Taunt.NotArea: An Area Attack hits everyone in the area - it can't be Taunted onto one crawler.

Roll.EvadeMajorFail: Major Fail: this crawler takes extra damage equal to the current Floor Number and gains a Minor Injury Debuff after combat.
Roll.EvadeCriticalFail: Critical Fail: this crawler takes double damage and gains a Major Injury Debuff after combat.
Roll.AdvancementAtCap: Already at its Rank cap ({rank}) - no Check rolled.

Weapon.SkillHint: The Attack Skill this weapon is wielded with (e.g. Longsword). An Attack with that Skill needs this weapon in hand or in the Hotlist. Leave blank if it isn't a weapon.
Weapon.NoWeapon: You need a weapon for {skill} in hand or in your Hotlist to make that Attack: gear whose Weapon Skill is set to {skill}.
Weapon.NoAttacks: You have no Attack you can make: equip a weapon or put one in your Hotlist, and set its Weapon Skill on the item.
Weapon.AttackButtonHint: Make an Attack with any Attack Skill you have a weapon for, in hand or in your Hotlist (it's swapped in for free).
Weapon.SwapNote: {weapon} is swapped into your Main Hand from the Hotlist, free as part of the Attack.

Dialog.DifficultyPresetHelp:
Unopposed (p.59): nobody stands in the way - Climbing, Dumpster-Diving, Endurance and most Skills for surviving the dungeon. 10 + 2 x Floor.

Stat Check (p.59): a Stat alone, with no Skill Ranks - resisting the environment or a Mob. 10 + Floor.

Opposed (p.59): against a Mob, Boss or crawler. 10 + their Stat Mod (or Spell Rank, size class) + Floor.

Custom (p.59): the GM may set any Difficulty that makes more sense than the formulas.
Dialog.AreaAttackHint: One roll; damage hits everyone targeted (p.83)
Dialog.UsesActionHint: Uses one of your Actions this round (untick for a Check the GM called for)
Dialog.AdvantageAutoApplied: Advantage pre-selected — Nat 20/Amazing Success Evade bonus vs. this Mob.
Dialog.ChooseParentSkillBody: Which Skill or Spell are you attacking with, applying {name}?
Dialog.StatHint: Off-Stat (p.58): the Approach may call for another Stat than the Skill's own (Survival with INT instead of CON).

TokenResolution.NoGMSelection: Select a token on the canvas first.
TokenResolution.NoActor: You have no owned token selected and no assigned character.

SpendStatPoints.Title: Spend Stat Points
SpendStatPoints.Hint: Each banked point buys +1 to one Stat's base value.
SpendStatPoints.HintMob: Each available point buys +1 to one Stat's base value. Available points are computed fresh from this Mob's Level and Tier, not banked over time.
SpendStatPoints.MobFormula: Level {level} x {statPointsPerLevel} points/Level, plus a base of {statPointsBase} in each Stat.
SpendStatPoints.Increment: Spend a point to increase this Stat by 1
SpendStatPoints.Decrement: Refund a point, decreasing this Stat by 1

Warning.DebuffBlocksAction: {name} has {debuff} and can't do that. Remove the Debuff to roll anyway.
Warning.PassiveNoCheck: {name} is a Passive Skill - it doesn't use Skill Checks.
Warning.RollNeedsOwner: This item has no owning Actor to roll for.
Warning.DamageEffectUntrained: {name} is untrained (Rank 0) and can't be applied as a Damage Effect.
Warning.DamageEffectNoParentSkill: You don't know any Skill or Spell that can use {name}.
Warning.NoDamageEffects: {skill} can't use a Damage Effect, so {name} can't be used with it (p.179).

Cooldown.Label: Cooldown
Cooldown.AskBody: {name} is still cooling down ({left}). Use it anyway?

LootBox.TakeHint: Give this item to {name}. You can also drag it onto any sheet you own.
LootBox.EmptyGM: Empty. Pick a tier and click Generate Loot, or drop items here.
LootBox.TakeFailed: {item} couldn't be given out, so it stayed in the box.
LootBox.NoCharacter: You have no assigned Character. Drag the item onto your sheet instead.
LootBox.NoGMOnline: A GM needs to be online to hand out loot.

Grind.SurplusBody: {name} ground {hours} more hour(s) than {skill} needed. Hours can't be banked on the same Skill, so apply them to another one.
Grind.PickPrompt: Which of {name}'s Skills gets the {hours} hour(s)?
Grind.NoTargets: {name} has no Skill that can take grinding hours right now. A Skill needs Rank 1 or more, must be below its Rank cap, and must be able to advance through use (not a Passive Spell).
Grind.ActorGone: The grinding character no longer exists.
Grind.LevelBody: {name}'s grinding hours have reached their Level: they gain a Level (now Level {level}). If they're the party's lowest Level, they gain 1d2 Levels instead (p.171) - the GM adds the extra.

MobAttack.AttackHint: Declare this Attack against your targets (in Declaration), or post it
MobAttack.ToHitHint: The Difficulty of the crawlers' Evades (p.267). "F" is the Floor.
MobAttack.DebuffsHint: Applied to each defender it lands on when its damage is rolled: not on an Evade, not on a full Immunity, not to a Catcher at Rank 15.

Trigger.majorFail: On an Evade Major Fail or worse

MobAttack.Subtitle: To hit {difficulty}
MobAttack.FreeEvadeNote: Disadvantaged Attack: the target gets a free Evade Check. If it fails, they may still spend an Action to Evade again.

Setting.Name: Phased combat
Setting.Hint: Run fights against Mobs in the rulebook's phases (Mob Declaration, Crawler Reaction, Resolution, Crawler Actions, Clean Up), advanced by the GM from the Combat Tracker. Off: combat uses Foundry's turns, and Mob Attacks resolve as soon as they're rolled. Fights between crawlers only always use initiative.

Notice.surprise: The crawlers surprised their foes: each crawler gets one free Action before the Mobs act.
Notice.declare: The GM declares what each Mob is doing: its movement, its Attacks and their targets.
Notice.react: Use Interrupts against the declared Attacks: Evade, Taunt, Catcher, Heal, Intervene.
Notice.resolve: The Mobs' Attacks land on everyone who didn't Evade them.
Notice.act: Spend your remaining Actions, in any order.

Phase.Speaker: Combat
Phase.GMOnly: Only a GM can change the combat phase.
Phase.CannotRewind: Damage from this round has already been applied - the phase can't go back.
Phase.FinishRoundFirst: Finish this round's phases first: the round ends from the Crawler Action Phase.

Declare.Title: Declare Attacks
Declare.TargetFirst: Target the crawlers this Mob attacks (T), then pick an Attack.
Declare.AttackHint: Declare this Attack against your targets. Shift-click skips the dialog.
Declare.NoAttacks: This Mob has no Attacks on its sheet.
Declare.NoTargets: Target the crawlers this Mob attacks first.
Declare.GMOnly: Only the GM can declare Mob Attacks.

Intervene.Hint: Spend an Action to help {name}: roll 1d6 and add it to their total.
Intervene.Closed: It's too late to Intervene on this Check: its result has been used, or its round is over.

Actions.NoneLeft: {name} has no Actions left this round. The GM can add one from the Combat Tracker (right-click).
Actions.NoAttackLeft: {name} has no Action left that can Attack (a Mob's Move or an AI Favor Action can't). The GM can add one from the Combat Tracker.
Actions.NoFavor: {name} has no AI Favor to spend.
Actions.FavorUsed: {name} already has this round's AI Favor Action.
Actions.FavorButton: AI Favor: spend 1 for an extra non-Attack Action this round

Undo.Blocked: That Action can't be undone. The GM can add an Action from the Combat Tracker instead.
Undo.CardUsed: That Action's card has already been acted on (damage or healing applied, a target Evaded, a potion drunk), so it can't be undone. The GM can add an Action from the Combat Tracker instead.
Undo.ReactionLocked: The Reaction card is locked, so that Action can't be undone.
Undo.ReactionChanged: The Reaction card has changed since that Action. Undo the later ones first, or the GM can add an Action from the Combat Tracker.
Undo.GearChanged: Gear has been moved by a later Action since. Undo that one first.
Undo.InterveneFirst: Someone has Intervened on that Action's card. Their Intervene has to be undone first.
Undo.DeclarationOver: The Declaration Phase is over, so that declared Attack can't be withdrawn.
Undo.Learned: A Spell learned from a Spellbook can't be unlearned. The GM can add an Action from the Combat Tracker instead.

Reaction.Title: Mob Attacks - Round {round}
Reaction.LockedNote: Damage is rolled on the Damage card.
Reaction.HasEffect: This Attack has an effect: open the row to read it.
Reaction.TauntRangeConfirm: {mob} is {distance} ft from {name}, beyond Taunt's range of {range} ft. Taunt anyway?
Reaction.PullAreaHint: Re-aim this Mob's Area Attacks at {name}: they take them in full, and the crawlers they were going to hit are no longer in them. Re-declare an Attack if someone would still be caught.
Reaction.AreaPulledSpared: Area Attacks re-aimed at {name} - no longer hitting {spared}.
Reaction.LockWarning: {names} haven't Evaded the Attacks still landing on them - they'll take the hits. Lock the results anyway?

Resolve.RolledTip: Rolled {rolled}; {raw} against this target, {final} after DR and Resistances
Resolve.CatcherNoDebuffs: Catcher Rank 15: its Debuffs don't apply
Resolve.MinorInjury: {name} gains a Minor Injury after combat (Evade failed by 10 or more).
Resolve.MajorInjury: {name} gains a Major Injury after combat (Natural 1 on the Evade).
Resolve.UnrolledWarning: {count} Mob Attack(s) haven't had their damage rolled. Roll them now and move on to the Crawler Action Phase?

RoundEnd.Title: End of Round {round}
RoundEnd.Subtitle: Debuffs
RoundEnd.DotDigest: {name} - {debuff}: {raw} rolled, {final} after Resistances (DR bypassed), {slots} HB slot(s) lost
RoundEnd.DotWhileDying: {name} is Dying: {debuff} takes 1 off the countdown instead of dealing damage.
RoundEnd.FatalSaved: {name} passes the CON Check: {debuff} ends and its damage is avoided.
RoundEnd.FatalFailed: {name} fails the CON Check against fatal Debuff damage.
RoundEnd.RestoreHbBlocked: {name} can't be healed ({debuff}) - {source} restores no Health Bar slots.
RoundEnd.DyingHealed: {name} is healed and no longer Dying.

Blinded.Label: Blinded
Blinded.Effect: Roll all sight-based Skill Checks with Disadvantage.
Blinded.MobEffect: Sight-based Difficulties of this Mob (its Attacks, and usually its Evade) drop by 5.

BloodTrail.Label: Blood Trail
BloodTrail.MobEffect: 1d6+Floor damage, applied at end of round. Stackable.

Burned.Label: Burned
Burned.MobEffect: 1d10+Floor Fire damage, applied at end of round.

Drowning.Label: Drowning
Drowning.MobEffect: 1d6+Floor damage, applied at end of round.

Dying.Label: Dying
Dying.Effect: Can't act. CON Mod = rounds until death; further damage just ticks the countdown.

Enraged.Label: Enraged
Enraged.Effect: May only perform Attack and Move Actions.

Fatigued.Label: Fatigued
Fatigued.Effect: -1 penalty to all Checks; Move halved. Stackable.
Fatigued.MobEffect: -1 per stack to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties); Move halved.

Held.Label: Held
Held.Effect: Can't use Move Actions or take a Step. Attacks against you made with Advantage.

LongTermMajorInjury.Label: Long-Term Major Injury
LongTermMajorInjury.MobEffect: -5 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

LongTermMinorInjury.Label: Long-Term Minor Injury
LongTermMinorInjury.MobEffect: -2 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

MajorInjury.Label: Major Injury
MajorInjury.Effect: -5 penalty to all Checks. A 2nd Major Injury upgrades to Long-Term Major Injury.
MajorInjury.MobEffect: -5 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties). A 2nd Major Injury upgrades to Long-Term Major Injury.

MinorInjury.Label: Minor Injury
MinorInjury.Effect: -2 penalty to all Checks. A 2nd Minor Injury upgrades to Long-Term Minor Injury.
MinorInjury.MobEffect: -2 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties). A 2nd Minor Injury upgrades to Long-Term Minor Injury.

Poisoned.Label: Poisoned
Poisoned.MobEffect: 1d8+Floor Poison damage, applied at end of round. Stackable.

Queasy.Label: Queasy
Queasy.Effect: Next Action requiring a roll is made with Disadvantage.
Queasy.MobEffect: This Mob's next Attack Difficulty drops by 5; the target gets a free Evade Check.

Sepsis.Label: Sepsis
Sepsis.Effect: Gains Staggered; 1d10+Floor Poison damage/round until healed.
Sepsis.MobEffect: Gains Staggered; 1d10+Floor Poison damage, applied at end of round, until healed.

ShitFaced.Label: Shit-Faced
ShitFaced.MobEffect: All of this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties) drop by 5.

SoreAsShit.Label: Sore as Shit
SoreAsShit.MobEffect: -1 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

Staggered.Label: Staggered
Staggered.Effect: Next Action can't be a Move; if it's an Attack, made with Disadvantage; can't take a 10ft Step.
Staggered.MobEffect: Next Action can't be a Move; if it's an Attack, its Difficulty drops by 5 (target gets a free Evade Check); can't take a 10ft Step.

Stunned.Label: Stunned
Stunned.MobEffect: The next Difficulty a crawler rolls against this Mob drops by 5 (if it's this Mob's Attack, the target also gets a free Evade Check).

TakeDown.Label: Take Down
TakeDown.Effect: Fall prone; Attacks against you made with Advantage.

Terrified.Label: Terrified
Terrified.Effect: Can't take Move Actions or 10ft Steps; Attacks made with Disadvantage.
Terrified.MobEffect: Can't take Move Actions or 10ft Steps; this Mob's Attack Difficulties drop by 5 (target gets a free Evade Check).

Woozy.Label: Woozy
Woozy.Effect: Can't add DEX Mod to Attack or Evade Checks.
Woozy.MobEffect: This Mob's Evade (and any DEX-based Attack) Difficulty doesn't include its DEX Mod.
